chunks: Yunus, from Sowrat ibn Kuleyb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
regarding the statement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted
Our Lord! Show us those who led us astray from among the jinn and the men, that we may trample them under our feet so that they may be of the lowest.

He said: 'O Sowrat! Those two, by Allah, those two, three times. By Allah, O Sowrat, we are the Treasurers of the Knowledge of Allah in the sky, and we are the Treasurers of the Knowledge of Allah in the earth.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'two' mentioned in the verse about those who led us astray according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the phrase 'those two' in Quran 41:29 as referring specifically to Abu Bakr and Umar, linking their historical role to the concept of misguidance. He further elevates the status of the Imams by declaring them the exclusive 'treasurers of God’s knowledge' (khazzanat 'ilm Allah) in both the celestial and terrestrial realms, a key Shia doctrine affirming their spiritual and intellectual authority.
